newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended slightly up on Tuesday, but were off early highs as position-squaring by speculators offset earlier gains.

"There has been no change in fundamentals and the index's rise was abnormal," dealer Mumtaz Kazmi said. "The index will move in a narrow band until political uncertainty persists and the final outcome of Pakistan-IMF talks."

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 1.17 points, or 0.08 percent, to end at 1,434.51 from 1,449.91 at noon. Gainers led losers 126 to 90. Hub Power rose 0.50 to 33.65 rupees and Lever Brothers 15 to 645. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
